findings.summary: Grayscale print of the dimensions page was not run: no PDF rasterizer is available in this environment (pdftoppm, mutool, gs, magick absent). Legibility is checked by text extraction in tests/unit/pdfRenderer.test.ts only. Command that could not run: print or convert an exported PDF page to grayscale and confirm each bar shows 'N de 100', the dashed 50 line, and 'abaixo de 50' with a hatched fill under the line; each matrix mark shows its number.

Still calls the old renderReportPdf(buildReportModel(...)) signature. Re-run on the current tree: `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` exits 1 with server/services/reportService.ts(70,9) TS2739, and `pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts` exits 1 with 23 failed / 14 passed ('document.pages is not iterable'). This is outside this unit's files and belongs to phase-1-backend-report-api, which is implementing that file concurrently. The unit's own gate passes; the integration check fails until that unit rewires the service to renderReportPdf(buildDiagnosisDocument(...)).
End-to-end export and open (AC-ra-05 e2e, AC-ra-17..19) and `pnpm build` were not run: both need reportService and reportRoutes rewired first. Deferred to integration.

messages.text: Remaining checks for this capability, not run by this unit: (1) pnpm exec tsc --noEmit must be clean after server/services/reportService.ts calls renderReportPdf(buildDiagnosisDocument({...})); (2) pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts must pass (currently 23 failures from the old signature); (3) pnpm build; (4) e2e export of a diagnosis with a score under 50, opened in a PDF viewer; (5) grayscale print of the dimensions page per AC-ra-07.

The renderer relies on these ReportDocument conventions: the riskMatrix block is immediately followed by the riskList block on the risks page (drawn side by side, server/report/pdfRenderer.ts:99); page.title is the sheet heading on every page without a cover block (pdfRenderer.ts:91-93); the footer text comes from document.footer.text (pdfRenderer.ts:168). The implementer reports these hold for buildDiagnosisDocument; the unit's tests pass against it.

evidence.result: No defect found in the unit files. renderReportPdf draws one sheet per document page; Sheet.require throws PageOverflowError above the footer; drawBar labels the 50 line, writes the score in words, hatches and writes 'abaixo de 50' under the line; drawRiskMatrix numbers every mark; drawRiskSpread places matrix and list side by side. Tests map to AC-ra-06 (line 198), AC-ra-07 (259), AC-ra-08 (308) and overflow (380).
